notes:
PASS on the fake backend: python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/linqi-ye__robot-universe --backend fake exited 0 with G1-G5 and G9 pass and G6/G7/G8 warn. The evidence state is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The package is model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run ros-wave-c-107) and unreviewed: driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null. No hardware was attached and no hardware, live ROS or MuJoCo engine run is claimed. The clone at commit 3f2de2ab27f18cd677cf159afe1992a42daa24d8 was read only and is unmodified (git status clean); no upstream code was imported, installed or run.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card is family:ros with RosDriver, but the pinned repository is a collection of robot description files (README.md:1-2) and the card's models are MJCF scenes. The go_bdx model directory has no ROS package, launch file, node, topic, service, action or controller executable, so the card's RosDriver has no pinned endpoint or type to bind for models[0]. The package instead serves the card's models[0], go_bdx/scene.xml, as a configuration-only MujocoDriver: device mhs://localhost/go-bdx, kind world.sim, mode simulated, risk R0. cap.world.step.v1 applies {ticks, action: {ctrl: [...]}} to data.ctrl and runs mj_step; cap.world.reset.v1 runs mj_resetData + mj_forward. The card's other models (birdy_v1/mujoco/scene_birdy_v1.xml, birdy_v1/mujoco/scene_birdy_v1_L.xml, PF_P441A/xml/robot.xml and PF_TRON1A/xml/robot.xml) are not served by this package.

MODEL AND LIMITS: scene.xml:1-2 includes go_bdx.xml; go_bdx.xml:1-2 sets the radian compiler and mesh directory; :64 declares the freejoint; :163-179 declares 16 position actuators with explicit ctrlrange values (hip, knee, ankle and neck -30 to 30, head -5.55 to 5.55, antenna -13.62 to 13.62). The bridge derives the cap.world.step.v1 action.ctrl bounds from actuator_ctrlrange and refuses an out-of-range element before writing data.ctrl. The package declares no Limit and no operator-required bound, so no site-limits.example.json is needed. The hinge joint range -0.785398 to 0.785398 rad (go_bdx.xml:8-35) is narrower than the actuator ctrlrange; it is recorded as a model Fact and is not reinterpreted as a control limit.

FAKE: MuJoCo is not installed and cannot be installed where the gate runs, so backends['fake'] is the package's pure Python stand-in mujoco module, .fake:FakeMujoco. It expands the scene's include and parses the same MJCF for 23 qpos, 22 qvel, 16 actuators and their ctrlranges, but its integration is a placeholder first-order motion of each actuated hinge; it loads no mesh or texture and resolves no contact, equality, tendon or sensor, and it does not integrate the freejoint or the floating base. Its 0.002 s timestep is a placeholder for MuJoCo's library default because the clone states no timestep (go_bdx.xml:4-5). It exposes no mj_getState/mj_setState/mj_stateSize, so the bridge uses its basic checkpoint profile. The sim backend (a backend name not in backends, which imports the real mujoco module and loads the same file) was not run. Nothing was compared with the real engine. The fake returns the full model arrays, not a reduced stand-in.

WARNINGS left by the last run, all expected and none failing: G6.NOT_RECORDED and G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND (the fake is a stand-in mujoco module, not an upstream class the gate can wrap or record), and G8.NO_UNIT x3 for the bridge-derived integer inputs ticks, action.ctrl[*] and seed. G4 raised no REF_VALUE or REF_BINARY warning.

TESTS: test_driver.py keeps the required mhs.testing.check_driver(HERE, backend='fake') call and adds nine cases: model shape from the included MJCF, per-ctrlrange-group refusal with zero tick advance, boundary acceptance, step timing and hinge motion, actionless step, wrong ctrl length, reset to model defaults, fidelity contract, and the e-stop latch. All pass; the gate G9 run passed within its bound.

NOT COVERED: the real MuJoCo engine, its contacts, constraints, actuator dynamics, floating-base dynamics and sensor arrays (orientation, position, gyro, velocimeter, accelerometer, magnetometer); rendering; the card's other four models; the go_bdx URDF and placo presets; ROS, which the go_bdx model directory does not define; and any physical robot. The upstream is a description collection, not a deployed controller. The card's publish_review is required and its license_spdx is NOASSERTION, so publication remains the owner's decision. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run; the digest above is the line the last check printed.

MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): Checked the MujocoDriver deviation (the clone is a robot description collection; go_bdx has no ROS file, and the card's models[0] go_bdx/scene.xml includes an MJCF with a freejoint, 16 hinges and 16 position actuators with explicit ctrlrange), the model path and its 17 STL meshes (all present), the bridge-derived step envelope, all 11 facts, the stand-in fake and the lockstep latch, which does stop this simulation from advancing. Defects: the stand-in fake, which has no physics, published the real engine's F1 'mujoco:bdx scene' fidelity contract, which a test asserted; three facts said more than their lines (a 'so the model itself states no timestep' inference, 'rad', 'every hinge joint class' and the freejoint off lines 8-35, a 'so ... floating base' inference); and the docstring and facts.md claimed the clone ships no ROS node, topic, service or action, while panda5_test/src/panda5.cpp is a ROS 1 node (it receives UDP state and publishes joint_states and diagnostics; no command path) and many description packages ship display and gazebo launch files. The reviewer changed driver.py (fidelity_by_backend gives the fake its own F0 'analytic:stand-in mujoco module (no physics)' contract, as in the reviewed wuji-description, while the class-level F1 contract keeps the real-engine gaps, now including that the -30..30, -5.55..5.55 and -13.62..13.62 ctrlranges exceed every joint's -0.785398..0.785398 range; the stand-in's own gaps add that it ignores joint ranges; three facts narrowed, one panda5 source fact added, docstring corrected), test_driver.py (the fidelity case expects F0 on the served fake and F1 on the class) and facts.md, and regenerated reference.json, REFERENCE.md and check-report.json. The gate and collect.py --strict pass with the expected MuJoCo-family warnings (G6.NOT_RECORDED, G7.UPSTREAM_BACKEND, G8.NO_UNIT x3) and the digest unchanged (sha256:c50559068bf268a84a6f5ab02afafccbf708248a9c7d3c6a6403bc6782a79988); the author's notes on an F1 fake contract and on a clone without any ROS node are superseded. The card needs the owner's publication decision (publish_review required; licence not stated (NOASSERTION)); the package may not be published or merged into a published tree before it. For the human reviewer: Simulation only: a MuJoCo model of the go_bdx biped (floating base) loaded from the read-only clone; no hardware path and no physical robot. The real MuJoCo backend was never run; the fake is a placeholder first-order stand-in that also ignores joint limits. The step envelope comes from the model's ctrlrange (-30..30 for legs and neck), which is far wider than the joints' -0.785398..0.785398 range. The collection has no root licence and go_bdx carries no licence file or origin notice (its .meta files are Unity asset metadata); publish_review required, the owner decides.
